character_sheet: A hostile sea serpent: a 12x8x6 head with an upper mouth, a hinged lower jaw, two eyes, two fangs and a three-piece forked tongue, a neck, and a body of twenty-two segments that taper from 8x8 to 2x5 over 150 units, ending in a tail tip (ModelSeaViper.java:93-228, 34 parts). 160 HP, 22 damage, 12 armour; speed 0.75 in water and 0.25 on land (SeaViper.java:59-60, :136-144, :201-207), a water-bound navigator that breathes underwater (:148-159). On a 1-in-5 tick it picks the nearest living thing in an 18-block box - a non-creative player, any monster, or the attackable animals, never another viper (:301-319, :336-357) - chases at 1.5 and, within 4.5 blocks plus half the target's width, rolls its bite on a 1-in-5 cadence (:119; DinosaurMeleeAttackGoal.Presets.seaViper; BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:159-174), landing 22 with a knockback (:209-226) and poison one time in two (SeaViperBiteGoal.java:22-31); the synched DATA_ATTACKING int (:56-57) is held at 1 while it stands in reach (BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:168). Stranded, it hunts up to twelve blocks for water at 1.33 and dries out (:277-296); in water it heals with a splash (:321-324). It spawns above y 50 in daylight, no other within 16 (:411-419; ModEntities.java:159-160). Read it as a serpent: a travelling S-wave down the whole body that stiffens into a fixed S at rest, the jaw chattering and the tongue flicking when it closes in.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.0 of the rig (SeaViperRenderer.java:26; shadow 1.0, :28) on a 128x128 sheet (ModelSeaViper.java:229), seaviper.png (SeaViperRenderer.java:20); the hitbox is 1.5 x 2.5 (ModEntities.java:159-160). The original's ModelSeaViper(0.5f) argument was the wingspeed (ModelSeaViper.java:14), not a scale. The body is a position chain: the code places each segment 9 px along the one before it every tick (doseg, :331-343) - key the joints, never the positions.

groups.name: body_wave
groups.axis: y (and each segment's x / z position)
groups.amplitude: the base: pi x 0.1 = 0.314 rad (18 deg) x the walking speed; every segment behind: pi x 0.2 = 0.628 rad (36 deg) x the speed, lagged pi/4 per segment index (2, 2, 3 ... 21, so eight segments per wavelength), blended toward a static S-curve of cos(-pi/4 x index) - up to 1 rad - as the speed drops to 0; each segment is placed 9 px along the previous one's yaw, foreshortened by |cos(pitch)|; no threshold
groups.plain: a travelling wave runs down the whole body from the neck to the tail tip while it moves, and stiffens into a fixed S-shape as it comes to rest
groups.math: tBase.yRot = cos(t * 1.3 * 0.5) * pi * 0.1 * amount; for each segment (index f = 2, 2, 3, ..., 21): seg.z = prev.z + cos(prev.yRot) * 9 * |cos(prev.xRot)|; seg.x = prev.x + sin(prev.yRot) * 9 * |cos(prev.xRot)|; seg.yRot = cos(t * 1.3 * 0.5 - pi/4 * f) * pi * 0.2 * amount + cos(-pi/4 * f) * (1 - amount)
groups.source: ModelSeaViper.java:249-272 (the chain), :331-343 (doseg); wingspeed 0.5 (:14); a negative limbSwingAmount is clamped to 0 (:244-246)
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.3 x 0.5 = 0.65: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.65 = 9.67 ticks; the wave travels one segment per pi/4 of phase

groups.name: jaw
groups.amplitude: calm: pi x 0.02 = 0.063 rad (4 deg) about a 0.45 rad rest at 0.2 x 0.5 = 0.1 rad/tick; attacking: pi x 0.17 = 0.534 rad (31 deg) about a 0.65 rad rest at 1.7 x 0.5 = 0.85 rad/tick
groups.plain: the lower jaw breathes slowly nearly shut at rest and chatters wide and fast while the attacking flag is up
groups.math: MouthBottom.xRot = attacking ? 0.65 + cos(t * 1.7 * 0.5) * pi * 0.17 : 0.45 + cos(t * 0.2 * 0.5) * pi * 0.02
groups.phase: the synched DATA_ATTACKING int (SeaViper.java:56-57, held at 1 within reach: BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:168) selects the branch
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.2 x 0.5 calm (a 62.8-tick period) and x 1.7 x 0.5 attacking (7.39 ticks)

groups.name: tongue
groups.amplitude: calm: pi x 0.03 = 0.094 rad (5 deg) about the rests 0.261 / 0.174 / 0.087 / 0.087 at 1.7 x 0.5 = 0.85 rad/tick, with a fore-aft slide of cos(t x 0.25) x pi x 0.05 x 16 = 2.5 px; attacking: pi x 0.07 = 0.22 rad (13 deg) at 4.7 x 0.5 = 2.35 rad/tick, the slide at 0.75 rad/tick
groups.plain: the forked tongue flicks and slides in and out - slowly at rest, fast while attacking
groups.math: f = attacking ? cos(t * 4.7 * 0.5) * pi * 0.07 : cos(t * 1.7 * 0.5) * pi * 0.03; ToungBase.xRot = 0.261 + f; MiddleTounge.xRot = 0.174 + f; ForkLeft.xRot = ForkRight.xRot = 0.087 + f; z = (attacking ? cos(t * 1.5 * 0.5) : cos(t * 0.5 * 0.5)) * pi * 0.05 * 16 added to each tongue part's initial z
groups.phase: the synched DATA_ATTACKING int selects the branch
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.7 x 0.5 = 0.85 calm (a 7.39-tick period) and x 4.7 x 0.5 = 2.35 attacking (2.67 ticks)

behaviour: One gait-scaled wave with no threshold (ModelSeaViper.java:249-272; doseg :331-343): the base segment yaws 18 degrees x the walking speed at 0.65 rad/tick and every segment behind it yaws 36 degrees x the speed with a pi/4 lag per index - a wave eight segments long travelling toward the tail - each segment placed 9 px along the one before; as the speed drops the wave blends into a fixed S-curve (cos of -pi/4 x index, up to 1 rad), so a resting viper lies coiled, not straight.

Two branches on the synched DATA_ATTACKING int (SeaViper.java:56-57; held at 1 while it stands within 4.5 blocks plus half the target's width, BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:168, dropped at :132 / :145 / :176): attacking, the lower jaw chatters 31 degrees about 0.65 rad at 0.85 rad/tick and the tongue flicks 13 degrees at 2.35 rad/tick, sliding 2.5 px in and out (:280-291); calm, the jaw breathes 4 degrees about 0.45 rad at 0.1 rad/tick and the tongue flicks 5 degrees at 0.85 rad/tick (:294-303).

The head, upper mouth, eyes, fangs, lower jaw and tongue yaw together at half the head yaw (:312-324), the lower jaw's pivot trailing the head's by 2 px along that yaw (:318-319) and the forks splayed 0.436 rad; nothing pitches. The neck is static.

The same wave draws it in water (0.75) and on land (0.25, SeaViper.java:59-60): setupAnim has no water branch. The bite (doHurtTarget :209-226 from the goal's swing roll, BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:170-173) and the heal splash (:321-324) are not animation events.

wishlist: in `swim`: the code's wave is uniform down all 22 segments (ModelSeaViper.java:331-343) — let the amplitude grow toward the tail and add a vertical undulation; the segments are yaw-only today
in `walk` (the land crawl at 0.25, SeaViper.java:59-60): a heavier, slower serpentine with the head raised; the code plays the swim wave scaled by speed
in `attack`: a strike — the head is look-only (:312-324) and the neck static (:97-100); a coil-and-lunge with the jaw snapping on the bite (SeaViper.java:209-226)
in `aggro_idle`: the coiled S-curve the code holds at rest (:342) with the head raised and weaving; keep the 31-degree chatter (:282-283) and the fast tongue (:285-291)
formulas: `ModelSeaViper.poseFrom` and `doseg` (ModelSeaViper.java:245-336 and :339-351; orig ModelSeaViper.java:302-357 in `render` (func_78088_a, :294-392) and `doseg` :394-402 (func_78087_a at :410-412 is a bare super call), wingspeed 0.5 from `new ModelSeaViper(0.5f)` in orig ClientProxyOreSpawn.java:497 - the port's WINGSPEED): a negative walking speed is clamped to 0. The base segment yaws by the cosine of the age in ticks times 1.3 times the wingspeed, times pi, times 0.1, times the walking speed. Each of the twenty-one following segments (the indices 2, 2, 3 .. 21: the second index used twice, as in the original) is placed from its predecessor - 9 units along the cosine (z) and sine (x) of the predecessor's yaw, both scaled by the absolute cosine of the predecessor's pitch (never written: the bind), in the original's double arithmetic - and yaws by the cosine of the age times 1.3 times the wingspeed minus the index times pi over 4, times pi, times 0.2, times the walking speed, plus the cosine of minus the index times pi over 4 times one minus the walking speed. Attacking, the lower jaw pitches 0.65 plus the cosine of the age times 1.7 times the wingspeed, times pi, times 0.17, the four tongue pieces pitch 0.261, 0.174, 0.087 and 0.087 plus the cosine of the age times 4.7 times the wingspeed, times pi, times 0.07, and the tongue's z offset is the cosine of the age times 1.5 times the wingspeed, times pi, times 0.05 (in blocks: each tongue piece sits at its bind z plus sixteen times it); not attacking, the jaw pitches 0.45 plus the cosine of the age times 0.2 times the wingspeed, times pi, times 0.02, the tongue pieces the same rests plus the cosine of the age times 1.7 times the wingspeed, times pi, times 0.03, and the offset is the cosine of the age times 0.5 times the wingspeed, times pi, times 0.05. The two eyes, the upper and lower jaws, the head, the two fangs and the tongue's base and middle yaw by the look yaw in radians times 0.5, the left fork by that minus 0.436 and the right fork by that plus 0.436; the lower jaw is placed 2 units behind the head's pivot (the bind) along the cosine (z) and sine (x) of that yaw. The walk position and the look pitch play no part. The GeckoLib hook is the same (SeaViperGeoReplacement.applyCustomAnimations).
